question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Monstrous**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Beautiful .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Monstrous" refers to something extremely large, ugly, or horrifying. It is often used to describe something unpleasant or terrifying.
 
• The most appropriate antonym of "Monstrous" is "Beautiful" as it conveys the opposite meaning—something pleasant, attractive, or lovely.
 
• The other options do not serve as proper antonyms:
 
 
• **Odd:** Refers to something unusual or strange, which is not opposite to "Monstrous."
 
• **Abnormal:** Refers to something not typical or irregular, which may align with "Monstrous" rather than oppose it.
 
• **Strange:** Refers to something unfamiliar or peculiar, which is also not the opposite of "Monstrous."
 
 

Correct Answer: *The correct antonym of "Monstrous" is **Beautiful**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Monstrous:** Horrific, hideous, gigantic, grotesque.
 
• **Antonyms of Monstrous:** Beautiful, lovely, charming, attractive.
 
• Understanding the context of words is crucial to selecting the most appropriate antonym.
